lessonsIntro: We have not confirmed a surf school that teaches at Runswick Bay. The nearest confirmed lessons are at Whitby and Saltburn.

text: Runswick Bay is a sheltered sandy bay below the old fishing village. RNLI lifeguards patrol it in summer (daily from 11 July to 6 September 2026, 10am to 6pm), but we could not find a surf school that teaches here or any official guidance on surfing the bay.

If you are new to surfing, book a lesson at Whitby or Saltburn first. Here, swim or bodyboard between the red and yellow flags when lifeguards are on duty, never go in alone, and check the forecast and tides before you visit.

text: The beaches on this stretch are mostly sandy beach breaks, so a long foam board is the right start, moving on to a hard mini-mal or longboard as you improve. Scarborough Surf School hires only 5/4mm wetsuits because the North Sea stays cold, and adds boots, gloves and hoods for the cooler months.

cards.label: Board
cards.title: Soft-top
cards.text: Start on a big foam board in small waves.

cards.label: Wetsuit
cards.title: 5/4mm most of the year
cards.text: North Sea water stays cool. Scarborough Surf School hires only 5/4mm suits and treats them as year-round wear, adding boots, gloves and a hood in the colder months.

cards.label: Other craft
cards.title: Bodyboard between flags
cards.text: The RNLI advises bodyboarding between the red and yellow flags.

shopsText: There is no surf shop at Runswick Bay that we could confirm. Saltburn to the north has Drift Surf Shop and Saltburn Surf School, and Whitby Surf School hires kit to the south.

lessons.q: Are there surf lessons at Runswick Bay?
lessons.a: We have not confirmed any; try Whitby Surf School or the Saltburn schools.
Daily from 11 July to 6 September 2026, 10am to 6pm.
Between the red and yellow flags when lifeguards are patrolling.

hire.q: Can I hire a surfboard at Runswick?
hire.a: Not that we could confirm. Whitby and Saltburn both have hire.
A 5/4mm suit suits North Sea water for most of the year.

shops.q: Where is the nearest surf shop?
shops.a: Saltburn, with Drift Surf Shop and Saltburn Surf School.
